title: MenuTune
description: Make the title music across versions!
body:
## 🎵 Enjoy menu music from different Minecraft versions on your current main menu!
Listen to tracks from **Beta**, **1.16**, **1.18**, **1.20**, **1.21**, **26.2**, and more, all while staying on your current version.

> ❓ Why doesn't this mod add in-game features?  
> Because there are already **plenty of amazing mods** that do that better! 😆  
> This mod stays focused on one thing: **main menu music**.

This mod is **lightweight**, **vanilla-friendly**, and built entirely around customizing the main menu soundtrack. You can:

- 🎶 Add your own menu tracks (`.ogg`)
- ✅ Enable or disable any song in the config screen
- 🔀 Choose how tracks play: random, sequential, or single-track repeat

### 🧩 Compatibility
Works with most mods that **do not heavily replace or redesign the main menu**.

### ☕ Support
If you enjoy this mod and want to support me, you can always **[Buy me a coffee](https://ifdian.net/a/vanillaessence)**. Your support means a lot! ❤️

Feel free to modify this mod or include it in your modpack.

---

## 🎵 让你在**当前版本**的主菜单里，听到**其他版本**的菜单音乐！
你可以在当前版本的主菜单中，听到来自 **Beta**、**1.16**、**1.18**、**1.20**、**1.21**、**26.2** 等版本的菜单曲。

> ❓ 为什么不提供游戏内功能？  
> 因为这方面已经有太多 **更强、更成熟** 的模组了！😆  
> 所以这个模组专注做好一件事：**主菜单音乐**。

本模组**轻量**、**原版风格友好**，完全围绕主菜单音乐自定义而设计。你可以：

- 🎶 自己添加菜单曲（`.ogg`）
- ✅ 在配置界面里禁用任意歌曲
- 🔀 自定义播放方式：随机、顺序、单曲循环

### 🧩 兼容性
与大部分**不大幅修改或重做主菜单**的模组兼容。

你也可以随意修改本模组，或者把它加入你的整合包中。
